column1: # The message table of the syntax layer.
# This file is the single source of truth for the messages this repository ships. It is not a
# translation table: it is the list of message IDs and the canonical English text of each, and it is
# what turns "this module's ids are complete" into a checkable property from outside.
#   id     dotted <domain>.<snake_case>, stable forever, never renumbered, never recycled
#   lang   the language this row's text is written in ("en" = the canonical source)
#   text   the template, strconv.Quote'd, so \n, \t, \" and the % verbs round-trip exactly
# One row per (id, language). A language may be added later without touching existing rows.
# The scope is the msg() surface of this module — every call site that hands a template to a
# localizer, which is what the consumer's catalog is keyed by. A template that is English today is
# listed with that English text verbatim, so writing it down changes no output; it makes the message
# addressable, and it is the only form in which a consumer can be checked against it.
